title: Senior Python Backend Engineer (FastAPI)
description: We are looking for a senior Python backend engineer to lead our FastAPI rewrite. You will own the API gateway architecture, work alongside a 4-person backend team, and ship to a Kubernetes cluster handling 10M+ requests per day. Postgres + Redis stack. Looking for someone with strong async expertise and production debugging chops.

title: LLM Integration Engineer (RAG + OpenAI)
description: Building a RAG-based customer-support copilot inside our existing CRM. Need someone who has shipped at least one LLM-backed product end-to-end: retrieval pipeline, prompt engineering, eval harness, observability. We use OpenAI + a hybrid Postgres/pgvector setup. Frontend is React/Next, but you'd own the LLM/back side.

title: DeFi Smart Contract Auditor (Solidity)
description: Smart-contract audit engagement: you'd review 6 Solidity contracts (Uniswap V2 fork + custom AMM logic) over 2 weeks, write a formal audit report, and pair with our internal team to push fixes. Requires history of public audit reports OR equivalent CTF/security work.

title: Shopify App Developer (Liquid + Node)
description: We need a Shopify app dev to extend our internal merchant tooling. Must know Liquid theme dev, Shopify REST/GraphQL APIs, Node.js for the backend webhook handlers. Bonus: Polaris UI experience. The current codebase has tech debt that you'd help clean up alongside new feature delivery.

title: HIPAA-compliant Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: React Native engineer for a HIPAA-compliant patient logging app. You'd own the iOS + Android codebase, integrate with our existing FHIR-aware backend, and ship through our compliance review pipeline. Past HIPAA / SOC2 experience strongly preferred.
